title: Translate
text: Translate image or video frame, 2 inputs, 1 output, {Interpolation method} sets Method for interpolating translated pixel values; {Output size after translation} sets the translated image size, {Offset source} sets the source of translation value Specify via, {Offset} sets the translation value, {Maximum offset} sets the translation value limits and {Background fill value} sets the intensity or color of background in translated. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Image
ports.summary: Input image or video matrix | array

ports.name: Output
ports.summary: Translated image or video matrix | array

params.name: Output size after translation
params.values: Translated image size Full (default) | Same as input image

params.name: Offset source
params.values: Source of translation value Specify via dialog (default) | Input port

params.name: Background fill value
params.values: Intensity or color of background in translated image 0 (default) | scalar | RGB triplet

params.name: Interpolation method
params.values: Method for interpolating translated pixel values Bilinear (default) | Nearest neighbor | Bicubic
